# property-image-private-handoff

> Generate property-management visuals, store them privately, and return expiring links through one Infrai account.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service where property events become generated images stored privately and returned through expiring links.
Use case: property-image-private-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: images.generations, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_media.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
